name: Organization and place search
primary_question: Which API should we choose for organization, place, building or local-business search?

decision_paths.notes: Use when 2GIS directory context, buildings and places are central; verify fields, rights, SLA and benchmark quality.
Use when the product is Yandex Maps-centered and needs organization/place search; verify storage/display rights, license wording, SLA and benchmark quality.
Suggestions are a separate product class from full place search.
Use the company verification route when INN/OGRN identity, registry provenance, risk or monitoring is required.

open_questions: Which returned fields are required and which may be stored?
Can results be shown to customers, cached, redistributed or embedded in SaaS?
What SLA and support terms apply?
Is batch or offline enrichment allowed?
Which benchmark sample covers target cities, categories, duplicate names and moved or closed organizations?
